dz: 罗马-波斯战争：朱利安皇帝率领罗马远征军（60,000 人）抵达安条克，并在那里停留了九个月，向波斯帝国发动了一场战役。
de: Roman–Persian Wars: Emperor Julian arrives at Antioch with a Roman expeditionary force (60,000 men) and stays there for nine months to launch a campaign against the Persian Empire.
